svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 05
svg.desc: Temple is switch-heavy. Follow the numbered rooms and mechanism markers, and regroup only after each split is complete. Use the source-numbered rooms as the route order; colored symbols identify switches, barriers, warps and fixed pickups.
